guardrails: Market-level mainline confirmation is zero or one; at most two deduplicated branches may be shown.
Missing capital flow may remain neutral in a radar score but can never satisfy strength confirmation.
Custom themes aggregate only observed mapped industry flows and fail closed when component coverage is below sixty percent.
Confirmed strength requires aligned price evidence, ready real breadth, a constructive cycle, non-negative observed capital, and price at or above MA60.
Parent and child sectors in the same hierarchy group cannot occupy multiple market-level roles.
The word confirmed is reserved for the selected market-level mainline; radar rows use strength and trend wording.
V2, V3, and V4 daily snapshots are immutable and are never rewritten by V5.
When a V4 snapshot already exists, V5 may conservatively reclassify that immutable decision-time evidence instead of rebuilding from expired intraday inputs.
The model is research-only and never places orders or changes stock-selection scores.
